name: Face Stealer, Moderate (Su)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Slayer 4th level, minor face stealer talent

Benefit(s): The slayer’s face stealer ability can act as alter self rather than disguise self, except the slayer takes the form of a small or medium creature of his own type, rather than a humanoid.
